title: image: support Sigstore bundle verification
body:
Resolves: #388 & https://github.com/ublue-os/main/issues/1477 & https://github.com/coreos/rpm-ostree/issues/5509

Add end-to-end verification of Sigstore bundles attached to container images. The image transport discovers Sigstore artifacts through the registry referrers API, retrieves the bundle, and evaluates its signatures. The implementation supports the bundle formats used by current Sigstore workflows, including DSSE/in-toto payloads, signing certificates, RFC 3161 timestamps, and Rekor evidence.

I tried to split the go dependencies into a seperate commit to make review easier. However, if there is a different prefered method please let me know and I will adjust the PR accordingly.
